preconditions.description: Mike's total beer consumption must be non-negative.
Joe's total beer consumption must be non-negative.
At least one of Mike or Joe must be able to drink at least one beer.

postconditions.expression: result == 'Mike' or result == 'Joe' or result == 'Non-drinkers can't play'
postconditions.description: The result must be one of the three possible outcomes: 'Mike', 'Joe', or 'Non-drinkers can't play'.
